usedFor: Microsoft Outlook receives the mail, and Slack is where the team reacts. “When a new email is received” in Outlook can post through “Send Interactive Message” in Slack, with buttons for the reply.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new email is received” in Microsoft Outlook, then “Send Interactive Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: An email often needs a decision, and the buttons or form collect it inside Slack. Plain “Send Message” only informs.

watchOut: “When a new email is received” is polling and covers the whole account, so every email will post unless you filter. An automation's post to a Slack channel also waits for your approval today.
